text: “Considering she has only known your brother since Wednesday, and only met your father and mother at a stray hotel—” “Could you possibly lower your voice? The shopman will overhear.” “Esprit de classe”—if one may coin the phrase—was strong in Mrs. Munt. She sat quivering while a member of the lower orders deposited a metal funnel, a saucepan, and a garden squirt beside the roll of oilcloth. “Right behind?” “Yes, sir.” And the lower orders vanished in a cloud of dust. “I warn you: Paul hasn’t a penny; it’s useless.” “No need to warn us, Mr. Wilcox, I assure you.
